This looks great — you've picked up everything I asked about, and reading through it, it matches what I had in my head.

A few things I especially liked seeing spelled out: pasting an address and having the title, description, and icon come in on their own (with sensible fallbacks when a page won't cooperate), the separate Read Later list that stays independent from favorites, being able to select a whole filtered batch and act on it at once, searching by `#tag` and combining terms with AND/OR and exact phrases in quotes, and the app just taking me to the existing bookmark instead of ever making a duplicate. The formatted notes and the reusable saved searches are the nice-to-haves I mentioned, and I'm glad they're in too.

One small thing I want to confirm I understand, not a change: if I archive something I'd marked to read later, it disappears from my Read Later list while it's archived, but if I bring it back later it returns to Read Later as before — is that right? Your write-up reads that way to me and that's exactly what I'd want.

That's the only thing I wanted to check. Go ahead and move on to planning — the specification is approved.
